ClipMyHorse.TV is the world's largest video platform for equestrian sports & breeding. 

What can I watch on ClipMyHorse.TV?
With more than 2.000 live broadcasts and a constantly growing archive from over 10 years of equestrian streaming, you can find events from all over the world. From now on also exclusively all FEI.TV content!
Furthermore, you will find numerous training videos as well as a variety of auctions, if you are looking for your new dream horse.
Everything we broadcast is also indexed, so you can easily find and follow a horses or riders development. 
We want to keep growing and improving! If you have any feedback for us, feel free to write it in the App Store or as an email to feedback@clipmyhorse.tv!
